column6: Robin bullet: "h > 0 gives uniqueness" stated for any PDE; false e.g. for Helmholtz. Added "For Δu = f".
f = 1 given on open (0, π), so the endpoint values did not show the series differing from f; changed to [0, π].
Listed 1D (|x|) as an exception to the power law, but |x| = |x|^{2-n} for n = 1; only n = 2 is logarithmic.
Solution stays bounded false for the file's own u0 = |x|; now "for Lipschitz data stays Lipschitz". Semiconcavity needs uniformly convex H (H = |p| keeps |x|-type kinks); added qualifier.
Said "compare three solutions" but gave only two; changed to "two".
Constant along characteristics when RHS is zero is false for fully nonlinear first-order PDEs (e.g. u_t + ½u_x² = 0); restricted to u_t + a(x,t,u)u_x = 0.
Three equations that differ only in the mixed term but first had 3u_yy; changed to u_yy, so B² - AC = 3.
Only weak convergence is guaranteed overstates; a bounded sequence is only guaranteed a weakly convergent subsequence.
